children: Investors have slightly lowered their expectations of the Bank of England future interest-rate rises, even though they still price in a quarter-point rate increase during the rate decision at 1200 GMT. Brent crude trades at $95 a barrel, down from over $100 a barrel earlier this week, due to increased prospects of a possible end to the Middle East conflict after Democrats gained control of the U.S. Senate and House of Representative. Investors price in a total of 94 basis points of BOE rate rises by the end of 2027, 11 basis points lower than the 105bps priced in at the start of this week, LSEG data show. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
